title: SurrealDB 1.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains a capability check bypass in its embedded JavaScript scripting engine, where the…
description: SurrealDB versions from 1.0.0 up to but not including 4.0.0 have a vulnerability in their embedded JavaScript engine that allows authenticated users to bypass capability checks. This occurs because the surrealdb.functions bridge calls internal dispatchers without enforcing function capability restrictions, enabling unauthorized execution of built-in SurrealQL functions.
